name: How long does the window sill replacement process usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does the window sill replacement process usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required for window sill replacement depends on the number of sills, the complexity of the installation, and the extent of any repair work needed on the surrounding frame. A single, straightforward sill replacement might take a few hours, whereas multiple sills or those requiring significant structural repairs could extend to a full day or more. Weather conditions can also influence the schedule, especially for exterior work. Maine Results, Inc. aims to complete projects efficiently, and we will provide an estimated timeline during your initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Timing depends on the number of sills, complexity, and repair needs; a single sill can take hours, multiple or complex sills longer.
